signals.title: EUR/USD — Sovereign Spread Widening + Downside Options Skew
signals.text: EUR/USD trades down 0.62% intraday at 1.1188, positioned below its SMA20 at 1.1464, SMA50 at 1.1530, and SMA200 at 1.1613. The German Bund 10Y yield trades at 3.45% while the DE-US 2Y spread sits at -182bp after a 5D widening of -43bp in the dollar's favor. OAT-Bund spread widening driven by French fiscal instability reinforces broad euro pressure. Options markets reflect strong downside demand, with 25d risk reversals at -1.53 alongside an elevated volatility risk premium of +2.9% (IV 6.9% vs HV30 4.0%). The policy rate spread of Fed 4.00% vs ECB 2.65% provides a +135bp carry advantage favoring the dollar. CFTC positioning shows leveraged funds net short EUR by -82,445 contracts (6th percentile, z -1.65), while retail sentiment sits at an extreme 89% long. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD; sovereign spread stress and negative options skew favor continuation lower. Catalyst: Eurozone Services PMI release at 08:00 UTC. Risk: French political tension abates and sovereign spreads compress sharply.

signals.title: USD/CAD — Geopolitical Oil Premium + Retail Divergence
signals.text: USD/CAD trades at 1.4268, holding firmly above its SMA20 at 1.4019, SMA50 at 1.3960, and SMA200 at 1.3854. WTI crude trades at $90.10, down 1.12% intraday despite Middle East headlines and geopolitical war premium concerns around Iran transit corridors. A significant monetary divergence anchors the pair, with Fed 4.00% vs BoC 2.25% establishing a +175bp carry advantage favoring the dollar (OIS SOFR vs CORRA spread at +157bp). CFTC data shows leveraged funds net short CAD at -72,519 contracts, while Retail sentiment data retail sentiment registers an extreme 96% short bias. The institutional long trend remains supported by real rate differentials, where the US real rate is +1.64% compared to Canada's mildly accommodative -0.07%. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CAD; rate carry advantage and retail short exposure support further upside. Catalyst: Canada Trade Balance and Ivey PMI at 12:30/14:00 UTC. Risk: Sustained crude oil surge above $100/bbl that drives aggressive terms-of-trade buying into the loonie.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Carry Premium vs Options Hedging Skew
signals.text: USD/JPY trades at 157.73, holding above its SMA20 at 156.26 while remaining below its SMA50 at 158.02 and SMA200 at 158.48. The baseline carry structure remains wide with Fed 4.00% vs BoJ 1.25%, yielding a +275bp policy rate advantage and a +264bp OIS carry premium favoring the dollar. However, the options market exhibits pronounced downside protection demand, with 1M 25d risk reversals printing at -2.36. VIX sits at 15.3, indicating normal equity volatility, but MOVE trades at 107.3 in the 98th percentile of its trailing-year range, highlighting cross-asset rate volatility. The 160.00 level remains the primary watch point where BoJ verbal intervention has previously intensified. Trade bias: Neutral/cautious USD/JPY; carry advantage is countered by elevated bond volatility and heavy downside put skew. Catalyst: Tokyo 10-Year JGB Auction outcome and US ISM Services at 14:00 UTC. Risk: US yields drop sharply following weak ISM data, triggering an accelerated carry unwind toward 155.00.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Technical Resistance at Moving Average Cluster
signals.text: AUD/USD trades at 0.6944, holding below its downward-sloping SMA20 at 0.7089, SMA50 at 0.7094, and SMA200 at 0.7033. RBA at 4.60% vs Fed 4.00% provides an active -60bp carry advantage favoring the Australian dollar (+73bp on an OIS AONIA vs SOFR basis). Despite the supportive carry and positive Australia economic surprises (ESI index +9.4), upside price action remains capped under the 0.7033/0.7094 resistance band. Options volatility reflects elevated demand for hedging, with VRP at +2.3% (IV 8.1% vs HV30 5.8%) and 25d risk reversals at -1.10. CFTC positioning shows leveraged funds net long AUD at +55,114 contracts, remaining in the upper deciles at the 79th percentile. Trade bias: Range AUD/USD; negative technical posture below the 0.7033 SMA200 offsets the favorable carry differential. Catalyst: Australia Ai Group Industry Index release at 22:00 UTC. Risk: A confirmed daily close above 0.7094 invalidates the technical ceiling.
evidence: RBA 4.60% vs Fed 4.00% — -60bp AUD carry premium
